ARE YOU INTERESTED IN JOINING A HYPER-GROWTH LOGISTICS TECH COMPANY?
Loadsmart is a growth-stage start-up technology company valued at over $1 billion (a true Tech Unicorn)!
We are looking for a talented Sr. Site Reliability Engineer to our team!
In this role, you will build and maintain the company's internal platform, driving operational excellence and empowering the entire engineering team. You should have experience in analyzing, proposing, and implementing safer systems and processes. Collaborating closely with engineering squads across platform engineering, you will ensure our applications are both safe and reliable.
DEPARTMENT: Engineering
LOCATION: Anywhere in Brazil - Remote
What You Get To Do

  • Collaborate with and support our creative, tight-knit development team
  • Design, deploy, and operate Loadsmart's critical systems while balancing reliability, cost, and agility
  • Play a key role in driving reliability projects with engineering teams
  • Utilize your intuitive problem-solving skills and contagious positive attitude to tackle challenging and exciting issues, inspiring those around you
  • Collect metrics and understand their business impact, encouraging the team to do the same
  • Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of system operation issues
  • Be accountable for the platform's Service Level Agreements and Objectives
  • Provide infrastructure support during off-hours as needed
  • Take ownership of software infrastructure projects
  • Seek, give, and receive constructive feedback through code and specification reviews.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Over 5 years of experience in Cloud Computing, SRE/DevOps
  • Proficient in English communication (both written and spoken) to collaborate in an international team with native and non-native English speakers
  • Detail-oriented with high initiative and self-motivation
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and how systems work under the hood
  • In-depth knowledge of modern networking and operating systems
  • Proficiency in AWS, cloud environments, containers, Kubernetes, Docker, and DevOps engineering, including managing tests and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with automation tools and provisioners like Terraform, Ansible, or Chef
  • Solid troubleshooting and system engineering experience in UNIX/Linux production environments
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, and incident management
  • Proficiency in automating tasks with scripting languages like Python, Bash, etc
  • Experience or exposure to PostgreSQL and DBA responsibilities is a plus.
WORKING AT LOADSMART:
  • Competitive base salaries - we believe in rewarding top talent
  • Extremely competitive Equity package - become a shareholder in our company!
  • Loadie Time Off - flexible PTO
Apply today!

title: Cloud Platform Support Database Engineer
description:
Product Development and Operations / Full time / Hybrid

Guidewire is looking for a proactive and solution-driven Cloud Platform Support Database Engineer to join our dynamic Global Support team. The Engineer will work collaboratively within the Product Development Operations (PDO) team, serving our customers in both Guidewire Cloud and on-premise environments. This role requires a keen understanding of our platform, backed by the continuous learning provided by Guidewire Education, Product Development, and Site Reliability Engineering teams. You will be learning new and exciting AWS technologies as we continue our journey on the cloud. In addition, you will work on multiple database platforms and utilize your skills in performance tuning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will be part of the Product Development Operations (PDO) organization working in a hybrid environment that delivers 24x7 service to customers who are using our software on the Guidewire Cloud Platform.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  1. Function as a primary contact to review, investigate, and promptly fulfill Customer requests and resolve incidents in adherence to team standards, thereby ensuring we meet and exceed customer satisfaction.
  2. Provide support for the Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL) production and non-production databases.
  3. Document and maintain technical articles, including troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, and runbooks, in order to meet objectives for customer request fulfillment and issue resolution.
  4. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of our database, platform and applications through company-sponsored training and experience.
  5. Job activities include setup (provisioning), configuration, monitoring and production support of platform and database environments on EC2 and RDS/Aurora platforms.
  6. Collaborate with the development and support teams, develop and foster strong relationships with customers and stakeholders, and act as a trusted advisor and technical point of contact.
  7. Strong eye for product and process improvements, collaborating with other departments within the company, following the escalation path if needed.
  8. Contribute to an environment that encourages information sharing, team-based mindset, cross-training, and an absolute focus on doing what is best for the customer.

Required skills and experience:

  1. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science (or a related STEM field), or related experience.
  2. 3+ years of experience working with and troubleshooting Oracle, MySQL, MSSQL or other database technologies. Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL is a plus.
  3. Working knowledge of one or more database high availability technologies and database data replication tools is an advantage.
  4. Unix/Linux general administration skills and/or python/powershell scripting is a distinct advantage.
  5. Experience in working with AWS services, such as EC2, S3, RDS, and (Kubernetes) ECS/EKS, to deploy and manage Java applications in a cloud environment is a plus.
  6. Experience solving issues with software code and reporting progress; preference for experience with a commercial customer incident tracking tool or CRM like Salesforce.
  7. Experience using a software defect tracking system such as JIRA preferred.
  8. Skills to read and interpret application server log files.
  9. 3+ years’ experience working directly with customers or key internal partners; preference for support for a B2B software company.
  10. Outstanding analytical and troubleshooting skills; with great attention to detail, ability to think critically and display an aptitude for problem-solving.
  11. We provide 24x7 support and the job may require working shifts outside of normal business hours and weekend shifts.
  12. Read, write, and speak fluent English. Score bonus points if you have skills in another language such as French or Spanish.

Personal Qualities and Soft skills

  1. You enjoy teaching and being a mentor to others.
  2. Good communication and presentation skills with an ability to explain complex technical concepts to a varied audience.
  3. Display a strong work ethic and do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  4. A highly positive can-do attitude, thrives in a team-oriented environment, values diversity, and actively contributes to team goals.
  5. Demonstrates strong follow-through and consistently keep commitments to customers and employees.
  6. Self motivated, and ability to manage multiple tasks with different deadlines.

Bonus

  1. Company pension contributions.
  2. Fully funded medical insurance for you and your family.
  3. Annual Wellness Reimbursement.
  4. 26 annual leave days.
  5. 16 weeks paid maternity and paternity leave.
  6. 3 paid days volunteering in the community.

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

A Limilk está entre os maiores laticínios do Espírito Santo, sempre acreditando na inovação e respeitando o compromisso com o consumidor e está continuamente em busca de novos desafios, investindo, crescendo e ampliando sua posição no cenário nacional.

Buscamos um profissional dinâmico, com experiência em logística, que esteja pronto para liderar e otimizar nossa operação logística tanto interna (própria) quanto externa (terceirizado).

Responsabilidades:

Gestão da Logística Interna:

- Controlar o estoque, garantindo a precisão dos inventários e a disponibilidade de produtos.

- Acompanhar a performance das equipes internas de logística, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e padrões de qualidade.

Gestão de Logística Externa (Terceirizada):

- Verificar a entrega dos produtos na transportadora e a eficiência no processo de armazenagem e envio.

- Monitorar e controlar o desempenho de prestadores de serviços logísticos, garantindo o cumprimento de contratos e SLAs.

- Garantir a integração entre as operações internas e externas para otimizar o fluxo de materiais e produtos.

Gestão de Transportes:

- Planejar e otimizar as rotas de transporte, garantindo a eficiência e o menor custo possível.

- Coordenar a logística reversa e o gerenciamento de devoluções quando necessário.

- Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de performance logística, como custos de transporte, tempo de entrega, índice de devoluções e eficiência no armazenamento.

- Propor e implementar melhorias contínuas para a redução de custos e aumento da eficiência.

Integração e Comunicação:

- Manter comunicação constante com as áreas de produção, comercial e financeiro para alinhar necessidades e garantir o atendimento de demandas.

Requisitos:

• Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração ou áreas afins.

• Experiência mínima de 2 anos em cargos da área de logística.

• Conhecimento em gestão de transportes, controle de estoques e indicadores de performance.

• Habilidade de negociação e gestão de fornecedores terceirizados.

• Boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.

• Desejável experiência em empresas de produção ou distribuidoras de alimentos, preferencialmente do setor de laticínios.

• Vale-transporte (ou ajuda de combustível)

title: R&D Jr Manager
description:
At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.

Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live a culture of inclusion, respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.

FUNCTION:

  • Lead the deodorant and soap bars formulas development in complex global product launch projects - major brand projects, higher financial impact, critical markets, more development and interfaces involved.
  • Focus on Deo and Soap Bar technologies and project deliveries such as formula safety and efficacy, industrial scalability, and microbiological resistance.
  • Teach and monitor analysts in laboratory operational activities and product launch processes. Be aware of the main category projects, as well as possible inter-project impacts and overlaps.
  • Occasionally substitute lab manager for budget-related activities, conflict resolution, resource allocation, and people development. Deep knowledge on stick, roll-on, and aerosol formats, as well as Alu-salts chemistry.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Teach and monitor analysts in the preparation of cosmetic formulations, taking into account the characteristics of raw materials, as well as activities related to product launch processes.
  • Teach and monitor analysts in the preparation of samples, considering appropriate packaging and identification according to the sample's destination.
  • Teach and monitor analysts in the interpretation and reporting of results, as well as recording information in the company's internal systems.
  • Represent R&D in product launch projects, dealing with complex global interfaces - major brand projects, higher financial impact, critical markets, more development and interfaces involved.
  • Ensure technical project deliveries such as formula safety and efficacy, industrial scalability, and microbiological resistance.
  • Lead activities for the development of new formulas (safety release, communication support, registration documents, art approval, industrial batch release, etc.).
  • Lead pre-development activities, involving new approaches to proposed technical challenges.
  • Act in conflict resolution related to the project portfolio and possible inter-project interactions and impacts.
  • Lead HUB topics such as process improvement evaluation, infrastructure extension, technical development tools, indicator visualization tools, etc.
  • Support the category manager in activities related to budget, resource allocation, and people development.
  • Responsible for compliance with Safety, Quality, Health and Environment rules and procedures defined by Beiersdorf.

PREREQUISITES:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Food Engineering or related fields.
  • 7 years of experience in research and development.
  • Deep knowledge of organic chemistry, nomenclature, characteristics, and functions.
  • Deep knowledge of raw materials and cosmetic formulations, preparation processes, and analysis methodologies.
  • Profound understanding of the internal stages of product development and launch.
  • Knowledge at deodorant formats (cream, stick, roll-on, aerosol) and technologies (Alu-salts and correlates) as well as soap bar formulation. Leadership skills, act as a professional model and inspiration.
  • Fluent in English.

title: HVE Sr Manager, BR Supply Chain & Integration
description:
HVE Sr Manager, BR Supply Chain & Integration

Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of Program Manager for S&OP team to keep delighting our customers by fulfilling products from Amazon and our Selling Partners at the fastest possible speed, on-time and at the lowest possible cost. The role is a part of the Brazil Supply Chain under the S&OP and Placement team.

As part of S&OP and Placement team, you will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence.

This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the Amazon Brazil Fulfillment Operations.

This role will give you a unique view of Amazon systems, process and operations, interacting with multiple teams and solving problems while the engine is running at full speed. It is broad and complex, with meaningful economic impact to the company.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.

Key job responsibilities
This role will work close to the Ops teams (Fulfillment Center and Last Mile) and Stores teams (Retail and FBA) along with multiple other teams to implement process improvements and new technical features to improve forecast accuracy. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused and used to work with ambiguity. They will have a proven track record in taking on end-to-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment. In this position you will:

  1. Set up robust processes to improve forecasting accuracy with an objective to minimize cost and maximize operations productivity;
  2. Make the existing processes scalable by identifying and implementing available tools/automation;
  3. Deep dive and analyze key business performance metrics, identify gaps, create plans to drive forecast deviations reductions;
  4. Develop new metrics and performance indicators to evaluate, audit and improve efficiency of S&OP forecasting.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor Degree;
  2. Experience working cross-functionally with technology and non-technology teams;
  3. Experience managing a team;
  4. Experience delivering cross-functional projects;
  5. Experience managing a program or project;
  6. Experience in supply chain management;
  7. Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- English for communication.

description:
Job description

Desenvolver, planejar e implantar normas e diretrizes, atuando na gestão das áreas sob sua responsabilidade, no delineamento das rotinas e sistemas de trabalho, nas estratégias para melhorias de processos, gestão do corpo clínico, na avaliação da necessidade de implantação de novos sistemas de trabalho e revisão dos já existentes. Exposição habitual e permanente, não ocasional e nem intermitente, ao risco biológico (Vírus e Bactérias).


Main responsibilities

  1. Desenvolver, planejar e implantar normas, políticas e diretrizes, atuando junto às áreas sob sua responsabilidade no delineamento de rotinas e sistemas de trabalho, visando à eficácia das ações frente aos objetivos da Instituição.
  2. Administrar operacionalmente a área e equipe que coordena, organizando e adaptando o sistema de atendimento à demanda exigida, de acordo com as férias e demais ausências dos profissionais, realizando escalas e garantindo o bom cumprimento da demanda de atendimento.
  3. Atuar em conjunto com outros setores no desenvolvimento de ações conjuntas visando à realização de atividades, revendo rotinas e processos, zelando pela integração e homogeneidade de atuação das áreas em cumprimento à demanda.
  4. Desenvolver em conjunto com a Diretoria, estratégias estruturais para a melhoria de processos da área avaliando a necessidade de implantação de novos sistemas de trabalho, revisão de padrões técnicos, bem como, mudanças na metodologia de operação e conduta dos profissionais, zelando sempre pela eficiência da área frente às necessidades da unidade.
  5. Orientar, monitorar e avaliar periodicamente as atividades do corpo clinico sob sua subordinação.
  6. Atuar de acordo com as exigências do Conselho Regional de Medicina e o Regimento Interno da unidade, fazendo cumprir as normatizações do conselho e Instituição.
  7. Assegurar condições de trabalho e os meios indispensáveis a prática do socorro de urgência e emergência, visando o melhor desempenho dos profissionais, em benefício da população.
  8. Acompanhar e monitorar o registro completo da assistência prestada ao paciente na ficha de atendimento de emergência/boletim de atendimento/prontuário médico, constando a identificação dos Médicos envolvidos no atendimento.
  9. Coordenar as passagens de plantões, Médico a Médico, na qual o profissional que está assumindo o plantão deve tomar conhecimento do quadro clínico dos pacientes que ficarão sob sua responsabilidade.
  10. Cumprir normas e diretrizes da Instituição e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde, bem como órgãos reguladores e fiscalizadores.
  11. Acompanhar a regulação dos pacientes fornecendo feedback para os profissionais sob sua responsabilidade.
  12. Realizar a articulação com os demais serviços do Município; Participar de fóruns/reuniões sempre que solicitado.
  13. Manter contato permanente com o NIR (Núcleo Interno de Regulação), com o objetivo de facilitar os processos de internações de pacientes, de forma a garantir que a solicitação da vaga seja inserida no Sistema.
  14. Reportar a Direção à identificação de necessidades, ações e processos em andamento, bem como o desempenho das atividades médicas.
  15. Analisar com criticidade os relatórios do atendimento da área sob sua responsabilidade.
  16. Participar das reuniões sempre que convocado e promover reuniões periódicas com as suas equipes.
  17. Garantir a manutenção e continuidade da assistência na ausência do Médico responsável pela visita/atendimento.
  18. Reportar tecnicamente a área responsável no Corporativo, quanto a estruturação dos planos de trabalhos, resultados e indicadores de desempenho.
  19. Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho.
  20. Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato.
  21. Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes.
  22. Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.
  23. Analisar a logística da unidade para receber campos de estágio e/ou residência (espaço físico adequado, quantidade de estagiários, equipe disponível para apoio e o impacto nas metas assistenciais), definindo a viabilidade de aceite frente às solicitações de instituições de ensino.
  24. Analisar a regularidade formal dos documentos relacionados a estágios, residências e pesquisas, bem como avaliar as propostas de contrapartida conforme as necessidades do serviço.
  25. Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM.
  26. Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  27. Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requirements and skills

  1. Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina com CRM ativo no Estado de atuação.
  2. Residência Médica Oficial reconhecida pelo CNRM, preferencialmente com RQE registrado no CRM do Estado de atuação, ou Título de Especialista.
  3. Pós-Graduação Completa na área de Administração Hospitalar, Pós ou MBA de Gestão de acordo com a área de atuação.
  4. Experiência em rotinas administrativas, e a partir de 03 (três) anos na assistência após conclusão da Residência.

Additional information

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  3. SLA, SLO, SLI: Conhecimento das métricas de qualidade e confiabilidade para o cumprimento de níveis de serviço.

title: GeoTechnical Engineer - Senior Level
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Geotechnical Engineer to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Geotechnical Group, the Geotechnical Engineer assesses and analyzes the ground on which wharves, quays, buildings and other structures will be constructed/operated; examine the soil, checks the flow of underground water, and conducts other tests to ensure the stability of an area before construction begins. Development of structural/ geotechnical projects of foundations and retaining structures.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare specifications, interpret field test data (SPT, sCPT, FVST, DMT) and estimate soil engineering properties for foundation design and soil-structure interaction (SSI)
  • Recommend and monitor lab tests on items in a laboratory. Interpret results, analyze soil properties, note any contamination or other issues, and produce reports about their findings for project managers
  • Perform construction site inspections and prepare inspection reports
  • Perform geostructural analysis and design of waterfront structures, including bulkheads, retaining walls, deep foundations, and flood control structures
  • Design wall structural components, including wales, tie rods, tiebacks, cap beams, etc., comprising local and global soil stability
  • Design of buried structures
  • Design and preparation of construction drawings and contract documents

Efetuar a negociação de compra de materiais diversos (matéria-prima, insumos, embalagens, componentes eletrônicos, importações e prestadores de serviços) e comprar os materiais administrativos, abrangendo desde o contato com fornecedores, cotações e negociações.

  • Prospectar e desenvolver novos fornecedores.

  • Fazer o acompanhamento do processo de entrega e cumprimento final de todas as condições negociadas.

  • Pesquisar produtos alternativos, conforme as possibilidades do processo produtivo, visando melhorar a qualidade do produto e reduzir custos de produção.
  • Atualizar as tabelas de preços de mercadorias com os fornecedores e repassar internamente a informação aos setores envolvidos.
  • Realizar visitas às fábricas dos fornecedores, para atualização técnica em relação aos produtos comprados.
  • Receber fornecedores, apresentando nosso processo produtivo e produtos para melhorar a relação no fornecimento e nas negociações.

  • Participar de processos de melhoria contínua, no que tange processos da área, buscando agregar valor ao cliente interno, mantendo o foco no cliente externo.
  • Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente organizacional.

title: Senior Consultant – Risk & Analytics (Property & Casualty Actuarial Consulting)
description:
Description

Senior Consultant – Risk & Analytics (Property & Casualty Actuarial Consulting)

As a Senior Consultant in the Corporate practice within Risk and Analytics, you will work on and assist project teams focused on developing and delivering reserve studies, pricing/funding analyses and captive consulting activities for our healthcare and corporate clients. You will be responsible for leading the team through data preparation as well as producing and analyzing initial results. You will work closely with a variety of senior colleagues who will help you increase your industry knowledge and sharpen your actuarial skills – all while providing a blend of client facing skills as well. You will play a role in supporting our marketing efforts and the growth of this practice area. As a project manager, you will bring order and process to the client teams with whom you work, and you will serve as a resource to analysts as you help them build their technical and client-facingexpertise. As part of our Corporate practice, you will be mentored by more senior colleagues with deep relevant experience.

The Risk and Analytics Corporate Practice includes over 100 actuarial professionals focused on large market, U.S. clients. Our primary services include reserving and funding for retained losses, captive feasibility, retention optimization, and cost allocation models. We also perform actuarial analyses of loyalty programs for hospitality, airlines and financial institutions, and are actively involved in the development of capital modeling and predictive analytics solutions for our clients.

As a Senior Consultant, you will contribute to varied and interesting projects such as:

  • Self-Insurance and Captives – Pricing/funding analyses, valuation of liabilities, captive feasibility, and risk retention optimization
  • Predictive Modeling – Development and application of advanced predictive modeling techniques to help clients improve loss experience and enhance overall business performance
  • Analysis of Loyalty rewards programs for various industries

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

  • Assist with actuarial activities on various project teams
  • Prepare the first draft of client deliverables for review by more senior colleagues on project teams
  • Seek and participate in key learning and development opportunities
  • Maintain steady progress through exams (if applicable)
  • Build strong internal relationships and collaborate effectively on cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrate natural ease and effectiveness when dealing with clients/colleagues at all levels
  • Train, mentor and serve as a best practices resource for junior colleagues, new staff and project team associates
  • Deliver superior, consistent project management for assigned clients
  • Deliver work in accordance with project deadlines
  • Grow and forge new relationships with clients; play an active role in client communications and delivery of results
  • Experienced colleagues will serve as the project manager on some projects which includes:
    • Creating project plans
    • Monitoring progress to deadlines and budget
    • Increased client interaction
    • Scheduling and managing regular status meeting calls
    • Ensuring appropriate and effective communication among team members and the client
    • Delivering projects that meet or exceed client expectations
    • Increasing efficiency within client teams by identifying ways to improve processes
  • Meet billable hour goals
  • Perform work efficiently and look for process efficiencies
  • As project manager, support project profitability through effective project management
  • Contribute to sales and marketing efforts by drafting proposals and responding to RFPs

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • Excellent skills across the Microsoft Office suite
  • Programing skills such as VBA, R or Python and proficient knowledge of manipulating databases like SQL would be an advantage
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Well organized and detail oriented
  • Proven experience successfully working on multiple projects at the same time while producing quality deliverables on time and within budget
  • Ability to respond to all communications effectively and in a timely manner
  • Strong client service orientation
  • Ability to ask the right questions and seek help where appropriate
  • Flexibility and proven ability to diagnose and resolve issues
  • Interest and ability to think beyond the task at hand and understand how one’s work fits into the broader landscape
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to draw conclusions and identify trends from data in a logical, systematic way
  • Ability to work both independently and on client teams and enjoy a fast-paced environment
  • Undergraduate degree required
  • Actuarial exam progress toward ACAS and/or FCAS credentials is highly encouraged

description:
Job description

Planejar, executar e acompanhar as atividades assistenciais por meio da Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) e processos administrativos do setor, visando a segurança, qualidade e atendimento humanizado ao paciente, em conjunto com equipe Médica e Multidisciplinar.


Main responsibilities

  • Aplicar as medidas de prevenção de eventos assistenciais conforme protocolo institucional;
  • Participar dos treinamentos obrigatórios da educação continuada incluindo os treinamentos de protocolos de segurança institucional;
  • Executar o cuidado integral, individual e humanizado ao paciente, com foco na definição da melhor forma de atendimento para o quadro clínico identificado pelo médico;
  • Orientar operacionalmente o trabalho de profissionais menos experientes ou com atuação operacional e contribuir no alinhamento das demandas da equipe da área com a liderança;

  • Instalar, acompanhar e realizar plano de cuidados para administração de medicamentos de alto risco prescritos pela equipe médica;

  • Auxiliar a equipe médica em procedimentos de alta complexidade;
  • Atuar como multiplicador técnico para a equipe, divulgar a diretriz da área/empresa, promover treinamento e orientação constante sobre as mudanças nos processos e procedimentos;
  • Executar cuidados de Enfermagem de maior complexidade técnica e que exijam conhecimentos de base científica e capacidade de tomar decisões imediatas;
  • Analisar, prevenir e efetuar controle sistemático de danos que possam ser causados ao cliente durante a assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Realizar visita de enfermagem aos pacientes da unidade, executando a SAE conforme protocolo institucional;
  • Planejar a escala de serviço da unidade;
  • Elaborar os planos de assistência de enfermagem aos pacientes;
  • Acompanhar as visitas médicas sempre que possível ou solicitado;
  • Realizar notificações ao Serviço de Gestão de Riscos via sistema Qualiex;
  • Avaliar e realizar curativos;
  • Realizar a classificação de risco conforme protocolo de Manchester;
  • Realizar coleta de gasometria, passagem de sonda nasoenteral, vesical, punção de catéter Porth-a-Cath e todos os demais procedimento dos técnicos ou auxiliares quando necessários;
  • Realizar punção intraóssea, passagem de máscara laríngea, troca de sonda GTT se o profissional for habilitado;
  • Apoiar na construção e revisão de documentos da qualidade;
  • Participar dos Comitês e Comissões institucionais;
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe, realizando o desdobramento das orientações realizadas pela Supervisão e Gerência;
  • Realizar as atividades conforme Regimento Interno.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior completo em Enfermagem com COREN ativo;
  • Conhecimento da Legislação do COREN;
  • Desejável conhecimento no sistema TASY;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ACLS (Atendimento Avançado Adulto)/PALS (Atendimento Avançado Pediátrico);

title: Analista de Contas a Receber
description:
Job description

Será que você é o ingrediente que falta por aqui?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa apaixonada por finanças para integrar o nosso time de Contas a Receber .

Na Pif Paf Alimentos, você vai fazer parte de um time diverso, dinâmico e criativo . Trabalhamos com muita colaboração e troca de experiências entre todas as áreas no comum desejo de tornar a vida das pessoas do Brasil e do mundo mais saborosa .

Se identificou? Então vem fazer parte da nossa receita de sucesso: #VemSerPifPaf!


Main responsibilities

Olha só como você vai contribuir com o time de Contas a Receber:

  1. Processando o fluxo de comissionamento, sendo responsável por realizar o fechamento e validar as informações de forma precisa;
  2. Monitorando e controlando a inadimplência, implementando ações corretivas para minimizar impactos e melhorar a recuperação de créditos;
  3. Executando o processo de baixas de recebimentos, assegurando a compensação correta dos valores devidos e regularizando as pendências de maneira ágil e eficiente;
  4. Contribuindo para o cumprimento das metas de desempenho, sempre com foco na eficiência operacional e na satisfação do cliente.

Requirements and skills

Para mandar bem, você precisa apresentar:

  1. Graduação completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas ou áreas afins.
  2. Desejável conhecimento do Pacote Office intermediário – com foco em Excel;
  3. Desejável conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  4. Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Belo Horizonte (MG).

Additional information

Fazendo parte do nosso time, você tem como benefícios:

  1. Vale Alimentação ou Refeição: para quem gosta de fazer aquela comprinha e preparar sua própria comida ou para quem prefere almoçar em restaurantes;
  2. Plano de saúde com coparticipação: para você e seus dependentes, visando o bem-estar e saúde;
  3. Plano Odontológico: para que possamos continuar sorrindo atoa com a saúde bucal em dia;
  4. ️Wellhub (academia): para cuidar da sua saúde e corpo;
  5. Cooperativa de Crédito: para te auxiliar a conquistar os seus sonhos;
  6. Vida Bem-vinda: programa de apoio a gestantes e futuros papais;
  7. Facilidade, praticidade e descontos em produtos Pif Paf: aplicativo interno para compra de produtos com entrega rápida;
  8. Parcerias para desconto em cursos e graduação: para quem deseja conquistar aquele tão sonhado diploma;
  9. Seguro de Vida em Grupo: apoio nos momentos em que você mais precisa;
  10. Kit Natalino com produtos Pif Paf: para deixar a sua comemoração ainda mais saborosa.

Como será o processo?

As primeiras etapas do nosso processo seletivo são feitas aqui na plataforma Gupy. Você terá todos os retornos por e-mail, combinado? Fique de olho na sua caixa de entrada ou spam, para acompanhar sua evolução no processo.

É bom saber: Aqui, na Pif Paf Alimentos queremos que, cada vez mais, as pessoas se sintam representadas e incluídas. Por isso, contamos com o Vozes, nosso Programa de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão . Gostaríamos de receber em nosso time mais pessoas de diversas gerações, raças, etnias, classes sociais, gêneros, público LGBTI+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Curtiu? Então #VemSerPifPaf .

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Technical Solutions Consultant, gTech (Spanish, English)

Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with project management.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Spanish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with external partners or developers.
  • Knowledge of SQL/MySQL, and Unix/Linux operating systems and commands.
  • Ability to collaborate, build consensus, deliver and drive technical decisions with various sized customer stakeholder groups.
  • Excellent technical leadership, project management, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills.

About the job

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self-help and in-product support to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts, implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers' business and marketing needs. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative solutions, and act as a partner and consultant. You will also build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and resolve technical problems and roadblocks around data and tools access.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize and automate workflows across a wide variety of projects.
  • Work with Product Managers and Software Engineers to improve or develop new Google tools and products.
  • Collaborate with Consumer and Engineering teams to write code and implement tools to improve troubleshooting efficiency and the end user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate with internal teams and external consumers, advertisers, and publishers to provide technical and business feedback as well as deliver technical solutions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to building a workforce that is representative of the users we serve, creating a culture of belonging, and providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), expecting or parents-to-be, criminal histories consistent with legal requirements, or any other basis protected by law.

Google is a global company and, in order to facilitate efficient collaboration and communication globally, English proficiency is a requirement for all roles unless stated otherwise in the job posting.

title: Product owner v saman co
description:
Venha se juntar com a gente na V4 Company!

Sobre o ambiente de trabalho:

Somos guiados por atitudes claras e transparentes em nossa rotina, que nos permitem fazer o máximo para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos de modo colaborativo, o que significa que confiamos nas pessoas que estão do nosso lado.

Aqui ninguém é empregado de ninguém. O ambiente é o mais horizontal possível, possibilitando a sua autonomia para tomar as melhores decisões para as atividades pelas quais você é responsável. Não espere pelos outros aquilo que você pode fazer por si mesmo.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Definir a Visão do Produto: Colaborar com stakeholders para desenvolver e comunicar uma visão clara e inspiradora do produto.
  • Gerenciar o Backlog do Produto: Criar, refinar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo que ele reflita as necessidades do mercado e os objetivos estratégicos.
  • Maximizar o Valor do Produto: Trabalhar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir que cada sprint entregue o máximo valor possível aos usuários e ao negócio.
  • Representar o Usuário: Ser a voz do usuário, entendendo suas necessidades e garantindo que o produto as atenda de forma eficaz.
  • Coordenar Lançamentos: Planejar e coordenar lançamentos de novas funcionalidades e versões do produto.
  • Monitorar o Desempenho: Acompanhar métricas-chave de desempenho do produto e utilizar os dados para tomar decisões informadas sobre o desenvolvimento futuro.

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Experiência: Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em função similar, com histórico de entrega de produtos de sucesso.
  • Conhecimento em Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento profundo de metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar efetivamente com equipes técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Orientação a Resultados: Forte orientação a resultados, com capacidade de definir metas claras e alcançá-las.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Habilidade de analisar dados e tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de se colocar no lugar do usuário e entender suas necessidades e motivações.

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Certificação: Certificação em Product Owner ou Scrum.
  • Experiência em Indústria específica: Experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos na indústria relevante.
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas específicas: Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de produtos, como Jira ou Trello.

O que mais oferecemos:

  • Ambiente vibrante, cheio de pessoas com o propósito de crescer;
  • Foco em metas, não em horários;
  • Gestão meritocrática, através de Objetivos Chave de Resultados (OKRs);
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.

Sobre a empresa:

Há 11 anos, lideramos o caminho no Marketing Digital, sempre em busca de inovação, nos tornando a maior assessoria de marketing digital do país.

Nosso foco é na geração de vendas e na transformação da realidade de milhares de empreendedores, dentro e fora do Brasil.

Existimos para vender o seu produto, vender mais vezes, vender para mais pessoas e vender pelo maior valor.

Estruturados em um sistema de franquias, temos mais de 250 escritórios no Brasil, mais de 6.000 clientes ativos e reunimos mais de 3.500 profissionais e mais de 300 sócios, entre Matriz e Franqueados.

Nossa jornada continua, queremos elevar a V4 Company a novos patamares, e sabemos que isso só acontece com profissionais excepcionais ao nosso lado.

description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 4 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 5 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work.

Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.

Vaga: Engenheiro de DevOps Sênior

O Engenheiro de DevOps Sênior irá atuar dentro do nosso time de Delivery Team, sendo responsável por:

  • Criar, configurar e gerenciar ambientes em nuvem utilizando AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud. Isso inclui a configuração de servidores, redes, bancos de dados, auto escalabilidade e balanceamento de carga;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e scripts para automatizar a implantação de aplicações, monitoramento, backup e recuperação. Implementar integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD) usando ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou CircleCI;
  • Facilitar a colaboração entre desenvolvedores, operações de TI e outros profissionais, coordenando esforços para garantir a entrega rápida e confiável dos serviços;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas em nuvem, identificar gargalos e garantir a escalabilidade dos serviços. Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento para obter informações em tempo real, identificar problemas e implementar soluções proativas;
  • Trabalhar com equipes de segurança para garantir a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura em nuvem. Implementar medidas de segurança como firewalls, criptografia e autenticação, além de gerenciar a proteção de dados sensíveis;
  • Desenvolver habilidades avançadas em automação utilizando Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Terraform ou similares. Escrever scripts complexos e criar pipelines automatizados para implantação e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;
  • Manter documentação completa e atualizada dos sistemas, processos e configurações.

Requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada;
  • Conhecimento em scripts e automação (Python, Bash, etc.);
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation);
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk);
  • CI/CD avançado (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.);
  • Arquitetura de Cloud (preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform);
  • Implementação de Infraestrutura: Projetar, implementar e gerenciar a infraestrutura de TI usando ferramentas de automação como Terraform, Ansible, ou CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento avançado de redes e segurança;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança DevOps (DevSecOps).
  • Experiência em projetos de grande escala e ambientes de alta disponibilidade;
  • Certificações em AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud.

Na IPNET, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Por essa razão, nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil: um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Vila Olímpia).

Benefícios:

  • Auxílio Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Transporte
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco Saúde
  • Auxílio Home-Office
  • Wellhub
  • Happy Day no mês do seu aniversário
  • Parcerias com instituições educacionais, tanto de idiomas quanto acadêmicas

Se você se identificou com os requisitos descritos acima, não pense 2 vezes. Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que abraça a inovação e onde o caos não assusta, porque somos um time que joga junto, possui um papo reto e uma cabeça de dono!

Job description

SomosMaisNaTIM Fazer parte da TIM é se conectar com o que acreditamos e ter MAIS sintonia com todo o TIMe. É aprender novas formas de oferecer ao mundo um trabalho com MAIS propósito. Aprendizado na TIM é MAIS que possibilidade. É o que nos move a fazer MAIS e melhor. É desenvolver habilidades com criatividade e transformar tecnologia em MAIS liberdade. Diversidade e Inclusão na TIM é MAIS que abraçar. É uma cultura cada vez MAIS essencial para o nosso dia a dia. É criar um impacto MAIS positivo sendo quem você é. Valorizamos a candidatura de Pessoas com deficiência, Pessoas negras, Pessoas LGBTI+, Pessoas 45+ e Mulheres!


Main responsibilities

Responsável pela prospecção e a gestão da carteira de clientes na vertical de IoT com foco de atuação no ecossistema envolvendo IoV (Carro Conectado). Assim, garantindo o crescimento das oportunidades comerciais IoT, conquistando mercado no segmento B2B, com foco na conectividade e no desenvolvimento do portfólio de soluções IOT & 5G. Também, como consequência, atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções ICT, AI, Cloud e de novas tecnologias nas diferentes verticais de negócio.

Principais Atividades:

  1. Atuar de acordo com o modelo de atuação definido para o time de vendas IoT & 5G;
  2. Garantir a cobertura da carteira com foco em maximizar as oportunidades junto ao cliente, sejam de IoT ou ICT, cuidando de todo o ciclo de vida do cliente dentro da TIM;
  3. Desenvolver e buscar novos negócios IoT aumentando o pipeline de vendas;
  4. Trabalhar junto ao Business Developer na estratégia de atuação e definição do modelo de negócio para os clientes do ecossistema de IoV (Internet of Vehicles);
  5. Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e capturar oportunidades prioritariamente em produtos IOT, mas também de produtos ICT;
  6. Entender a estrutura do cliente, seus processos e rede de influência principalmente no ecossistema de IoV (Fabricantes de veículos, Fornecedores de autopeças, Desenvolvedores de Plataformas, etc);
  7. Construir relacionamento sólido com os principais decisores e influenciadores, garantindo a aproximação da Diretoria TIM e demais hierarquias do cliente;
  8. Atuar junto ao pré-vendas na confecção da melhor proposta técnica e comercial de soluções IoT e ICT;
  9. Prospectar novos clientes através do relacionamento com o mercado e influenciadores/parceiros/fornecedores;
  10. Analisar a concorrência e tendências de mercado para levantar novas oportunidades e adequar à proposta de valor;
  11. Participar feiras de negócios, eventos, seminários, comunidades do setor de atuação e trabalhar a imagem da TIM para além da conectividade, como uma empresa de soluções de Tecnologia;
  12. Desenvolver relacionamento buscando aproximação de empresas pertencentes e relevantes para a comunidade do ecossistema de IoV (indústria, fornecedores, consultores especializados etc.).

Requirements and skills

Experiência e formação

  1. Especialista no segmento de IoT com conhecimento comprovado no ecossistema de IoV (Internet of Vehicles);
  2. Experiência na condução de negociações complexas de serviços em clientes B2B;
  3. Domínio do mercado do cliente identificando os impactos jurídicos, regulatórios, fiscais etc., nas negociações;
  4. Conhecimento Avançado no Pacote Office;
  5. Desejável Inglês fluente/avançado (escrita e conversação);
  6. Residir em São Paulo/SP;
  7. Veículo próprio;
  8. Formação superior completa em Administração, Tecnologia, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas.

Additional information

Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

title: Senior Data Management Engineer
description:
A leading U.S. call analytics company is seeking a Senior Data Management Engineer to drive innovation, harness the power of data, and deliver actionable insights to clients. In this impactful role, you will design scalable systems, build dynamic user interfaces, and enhance real-time analytics tools, enabling businesses to make smarter, faster decisions.

As part of the Product Engineering Team, you’ll collaborate across disciplines to develop robust APIs, high-performance data pipelines, and cutting-edge UIs, merging full-stack development with data platform engineering. Your work will shape the future of call analytics and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • API & Microservices Development : Design and maintain scalable APIs and microservices for real-time data ingestion, processing, and analytics, leveraging Azure cloud-native technologies (e.g., Azure Functions, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB).
  • Data Pipeline Optimization : Collaborate with data engineers to build and refine real-time data pipelines using Azure Data Explorer, Snowflake, and Kafka/Confluent.
  • ETL and Data Integration : Create efficient ETL workflows and perform complex data ingestion and transformation using .NET/C#, SQL, and PySpark.
  • Data Architecture & Storage : Design and manage data lakes and storage solutions using Azure Data Lake, Parquet, and Delta Tables.
  • Real-Time Processing : Work with big data and real-time data processing frameworks to support high-volume analytics.
  • Legacy System Modernization : Lead the migration of legacy platforms to a centralized "data of record" system, ensuring data integrity, eliminating redundancy, and improving operational efficiency.
  • Pipeline Innovation : Develop configurable pipelines via APIs to support real-time omnichannel conversational analytics and integration with tools like Twilio.
  • Performance Optimization : Optimize data processing and storage solutions for scalability, cost-efficiency, and high performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack development, specializing in data-driven platforms and scalable systems.
  • Expertise in C# and .NET technologies (preferably .NET 8).
  • Proficiency with Azure cloud services (e.g., Data Explorer, Functions, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB).
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and optimizing data pipelines for real-time analytics.
  • Familiarity with real-time messaging systems like Kafka/Confluent .
  • Advanced knowledge of modern web frameworks such as React , Angular , or Vue.js .
  • Experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with microservices architectures .
  • Strong background in data ingestion , ETL workflows , and real-time analytics pipelines .
  • Proven skills in query performance optimization and efficient data processing.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Java or Scala is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

A Bühler pretende equilibrar a humanidade, a natureza e a economia em todas as decisões, à medida que desenvolve soluções que abrem oportunidades de negócios sustentáveis nas indústrias globais de alimentos, rações e mobilidade.   • Graduação em Engenharia;

  • Profissional organizado e estruturado;
  • Visão estratégica e foco em resultados;
  • Resiliência – capacidade de trabalhar em situações de pressão;
  • Adaptabilidade e resolução de problemas.

Atividades

  • Identificar, desenvolver e selecionar fornecedores, estabelecendo parcerias estratégicas.
  • Negociar contratos e condições comerciais, visando melhores preços e condições comerciais.

Na Bühler não oferecemos apenas oportunidades de trabalho e intercâmbio internacional de profissionais com ideias semelhantes. Somos mais do que apenas uma empresa global. A nossa proposta de valor, que consiste em transformar a maneira como as empresas alimentam e movem o mundo, está impulsionando mudanças positivas nos setores em que operamos globalmente. Torne-se parte de um ambiente dinâmico que combina seu desejo de inovação com um mundo de possibilidades. Juntar-se a nós significa abraçar um propósito comum de inovações para um mundo melhor ao se tornar parte de uma empresa dedicada ao seu sucesso.

Senior/ Staff Technical Product Manager (Platform Team)

About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

Nubank’s continued success hinges on our Platform Product Managers, who play a crucial role in recognizing and solving important customer problems at scale. This role is vital as it synthesizes our broader business strategy with the needs of development teams across the company. By building products that create leverage for our business, these managers simplify and scale capabilities to unlock potential and mitigate risks. Their work impacts our core cloud architecture, data infrastructure, finance, security platforms, customer service tools, and other internal products. They own the goal of equipping Nubank to meet evolving customer needs for decades.

You will be responsible for

  • Defining, prioritizing, and communicating both short and long-term product goals.
  • Developing a deep understanding of users and stakeholders through research, data analysis, and interviews.
  • Specifying and refining product requirements from conception to launch, collaborating closely with engineering and, if needed, design, data science, credit, and finance teams.
  • Staying updated on complex areas like cloud services and information security to guide the team.
  • Acting as an evangelist, ensuring clear communication between the team and stakeholders to bridge understanding gaps.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Experience working with software products as a Product Manager or a similar role.
  • Robust experience managing the entire product life-cycle for successful tech products.
  • A strong desire to discover and fulfill user needs.
  • Confidence in working with numbers and data-driven decision-making.
  • The ability to build strong relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • An aptitude for turning incomplete or conflicting information into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with proficiency in presentation.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A deep willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • A good understanding of the software development lifecycle.

Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Health and life insurance
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
  • Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year
  • 15 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every two to three months, one week will be at the office.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

Are you someone that can make a huge impact on Amazon's ability to drive our business growth? Are you equally comfortable digging into business and technical requirements as drilling into metrics development? Then this is the position for you.
We are looking for Technical Account Managers to own and implement a roadmap of new strategic Amazon Initiatives with our Integrators in Brazil (Marketplace Hubs). You will be responsible for building relationships, providing technical support, and engaging our partner’s development teams to implement, maintain, and grow their integrations to Amazon’s marketplace.

In this role, you will be required to understand our integration APIs (Amazon Marketplace Web Service - MWS and SP-APIs), which is an integrated web service that helps sellers programmatically exchange on listings, orders, payments, reports, and more.

Thomas J. Watson said it best: “Good design is good business.” Visualization is critical to discovering data-driven insights and effectively communicating that knowledge to others. Does the thought of creating the platform at the heart of solutions like Watson, Blockchain, IoT, and Security excite you? If so, read on!

  • Please submit your resume in English with your portfolio.

Preferred Technical and Professional Expertise
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).

  • Proven track record of contributing to an inclusive and collaborative team culture, fostering trust, motivation, and creativity.

  • Ações de Melhorias do time de compras (PDCA): Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de compras e implementar soluções inovadoras. Promover a automação de processos sempre que possível.

Seu trabalho resultará em um aumento de eficiência e precisão nas atividades fiscais, atendendo de forma proativa às necessidades dos nossos clientes.

O foco de sua atuação será no enquadramento tributário (aspecto crítico para as empresas) e execução dos processos de apuração pertinentes ao setor. description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$57 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #248 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit , and read about the latest news via our StoryHub .

Description and Requirements

Lenovo is launching a new Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) digital business in Brazil, focused on driving direct sales of server, storage, and infrastructure products through Lenovo.com.br. As the ISG Brazil eCommerce Program Manager , you will lead the end-to-end go-to-market strategy and business operations for this critical initiative, with a strong focus on accelerating growth in Brazil’s B2B market.

This is a highly strategic and cross-functional role requiring deep ownership of ISG eCommerce processes. You will work closely with Brazil’s ISG 4P and Sales teams, as well as Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization, to deliver on revenue targets, shape the customer experience, and drive digital transformation within the ISG business.

You will own Brazil’s ISG eCommerce 4P strategy across Product, Price, Place, and Promotion, and be responsible for launching and managing performance marketing programs to generate leads, influence pipeline, and convert web traffic into sales. This is a unique opportunity to help build a business from the ground up and directly impact Lenovo’s global growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

4P Strategy Ownership (Brazil ISG eCommerce)

  • Product: Define the ideal ISG eCommerce product portfolio (servers, storage, and options) for Lenovo.com in Brazil, in close collaboration with local 4P and global product and category teams.
  • Pricing: Lead Brazil-specific web pricing strategy, including promotions, deal structures, and competitive price factor value (PFV) benchmarking, in coordination with ISG Pricing and eCommerce operations.
  • Place: Position Lenovo.com.br as a key digital touchpoint for B2B ISG sales in Brazil, while supporting an integrated, omnichannel go-to-market approach in collaboration with channel partners.
  • Promotion: Develop and execute localized digital marketing demand generation campaigns aligned with ISG sales priorities, leveraging paid media, email, and account-based marketing.

Program Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead Brazil’s ISG Web go-to-market planning, forecasting, and campaign execution in alignment with Sales, ISG 4P, Supply Chain, Channel/Reseller, and eCommerce teams.
  • Partner with Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization (site operations, merchandising, UX, BT/IT, and pricing operations) to deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Lenovo.com.br
  • Own and manage key business KPIs, including overall sales and profit contribution, web traffic, conversion rates, leads, ROAS and generated pipeline.

Market Activation & Reporting
